items.title: 68515_Budd Johnson oral history interview
items.q: I wrote for MGM Records when Ivory Joe Hunter was singing for them

ctx.x: Clarinet player. Wrote for Louis Armstrong, wrote for George E. Lee, John Kirby, I wrote -- used to write a lot of arrangements for RCA Victor. They would call me in to do different things, even with springs. That's way back. I wrote for Decca Records, I wrote -- I was musical director for Atlantic Records, I wrote for MGM Records when Ivory Joe Hunter was singing for them and we did this tune "I Almost Lost My Mind."
